title: Clawd X Digest
summary: AI Model Delays: GPT-5.6 is delayed to mid-July and DeepMind's 3.5 Pro launch is pushed back, while select customers gain early access to Claude Sonnet 5.
Open Source CLI Fallout: Developer JPoehnelt shares details of being terminated by Google for creating a viral Google Workspace CLI just prior to Google's official release.
Commit Co-Authorship Debate: Developers push back against Anthropic's Claude Code CLI automatically adding its name to git commit metadata as a co-author.
Baidu OCR Breakthrough: Baidu open-sources a 3B OCR model that achieves SOTA results, beating massive models like Qwen-VL and Gemini 2.5 Pro while running efficiently on large documents.
SEC Disclosure Concerns: Proposed SEC Rule S7-2026-15 faces opposition for allowing public companies to hide negative numbers for six months, raising insider trading concerns.
Sports Milestones: Michael Olise matches Zinedine Zidane's 1996 record of 12 goal involvements in his first 19 appearances for France as Bayern finalizes Saibari's transfer.

items.title: @Semper_Viventem: Claude Code Git Commit Co-Authorship Dispute
items.body: Developers are debating Anthropic's Claude Code CLI automatically inserting 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus <noreply@anthropic.com>' in git commit metadata. Critics argue that an AI assistant is a paid utility tool rather than a copyright holder or collaborator, comparing it to not crediting Visual Studio.

items.title: @synthwavedd: AI Frontier Model Release Delays & Stop-Gaps
items.body: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 has reportedly been delayed to mid-July, while DeepMind's Gemini 3.5 Pro launch is pushed past this month. Concurrently, Anthropic has made Claude Sonnet 5 available to select enterprise customers under early access as Mythos/Fable 5 progress stalls.

items.title: @JPoehnelt: Workspace CLI Creator Terminated by Google
items.body: The developer of the popular open-source Google Workspace CLI details being fired by Google after the tool went viral and hit #1 on Hacker News. The dismissal came just two days after Google announced an official Workspace CLI, highlighting corporate fears of agentic disruption.

items.title: @enoch4306: Baidu's 3B Unlimited OCR Model Outperforms Giants
items.body: Baidu has open-sourced 'Unlimited OCR,' a 3B parameter model (activating only 500M parameters) that scored 93.23% on OmniDocBench v1.5, beating Qwen2.5-VL and Gemini 2.5 Pro. The model parses 40+ page documents in a single inference without speed or memory degradation.

items.title: @NousResearch: Hermes Agent Learns Skills from Raw Code & Docs
items.body: Nous Research released Hermes Agent with a /learn command, enabling the agent to ingest entire directories of source code, API documentation, manuals, or configs to distill a verifiable, reusable skill.

items.title: @0xSilver_Time: ByteDance Launches Seedance 2.5 for AI Film Co-Creation
items.body: ByteDance released Seedance 2.5 alongside a novel IP licensing system on Douyin and Jianying, allowing users to buy passes to legally create AI secondary creations using Stephen Chow's classic movies like The King of Comedy and The God of Cookery.

items.title: @keepitquarterly: SEC Rule S7-2026-15 Corporate Disclosure Debate
items.body: Financial commentators are raising alarms over SEC Rule S7-2026-15, which would permit public companies to delay reporting negative earnings numbers for up to six months. Critics warn this creates a window for corporate insiders to dump shares while retail investors buy in.

items.title: @Farmer9911: Geopolitical Shifts in Ukraine's Territorial Goals
items.body: Observers note a significant evolution in Ukrainian President Zelenskyy's geopolitical objectives, shifting from settling for a ceasefire along the line of contact to actively seeking the return of all territories occupied since 2014, including Crimea.

items.title: @btcbqr: Domestic Tobacco Disrupted by Self-Rolling and E-Cigarettes
items.body: A price hike of 40-50% by the Chinese State Tobacco Corporation has triggered unexpected consumer price-sensitivity in rural and younger demographics, who are shifting to self-rolled tobacco and e-cigarettes, leaving retail tobacco shops struggling.

items.title: @jjauthor: Legislative Battles Over Immigration Policy
items.body: Political commentators are highlighting the asymmetry in legislative thresholds, questioning why 60 Senate votes are demanded to deport illegal immigrants when no such supermajority was required for their entry.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Michael Olise Matches Zidane's Historic France Start
items.body: Michael Olise has reached 12 goal involvements (7 goals, 5 assists) in his first 19 appearances for the France national team, matching Zinédine Zidane's historic 1996 milestone.

items.title: @Plettigoal: FC Bayern Finalizes Ismael Saibari Transfer
items.body: Bayern Munich has completed the signing of Ismael Saibari from PSV Eindhoven. Sporting Director Max Eberl reportedly secured a fixed fee below €50 million by concluding negotiations early before Morocco's World Cup opening match.

items.title: @cinemaclt: Haaland Explains Declining Tom Holland's Monaco Invite
items.body: Football star Erling Haaland revealed he ignored a dinner invitation from Spider-Man actor Tom Holland during the Monaco Grand Prix, stating that he does not watch movies and did not want to respond to a stranger.

items.title: @Furious_red_: World Cup Scoring Achievements of Messi and Ronaldo
items.body: Fans are analyzing the World Cup records of Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo, noting that while both have played in six World Cups, only Ronaldo has managed to score in all six tournaments.
